summary: Verified the craco.config.js static-HTML middleware fix for the blank dark-blue page bug. Tested root URL, all public pages, backend health, admin login, admin SPA fallback, and the restart race-condition (Emergent default template leak). ALL checks PASSED. Root '/' consistently serves the Instituto AOCP homepage (PMPE + CBMPE cards render) with zero Emergent default-template leaks across 2 frontend supervisor restarts (69 of 70 startup polls returned AOCP homepage; the 2 non-AOCP responses were ingress 502s during the ~2s window before the dev server bound its port - not template leaks).
critical_code_review_comments: craco.config.js middleware.unshift('serve-user-html') correctly placed AFTER visual-edits wrapper so it survives setupMiddlewares override; fs.readFileSync + res.end avoids res.sendFile-not-a-function; reqPath derived safely from req.path||req.url. Fix is sound.

During frontend restart there is a brief (~2s) window where the Kubernetes ingress returns a 502 Bad Gateway before the dev server binds. This is expected/unavoidable with the CRA dev server and is NOT the Emergent template leak the user reported. No fix needed.

Note: /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not contain the admin credentials (file only has header comments). Admin creds (donas/Seinao10@@) came from the review request and were verified working. Recommend main agent persist these to test_credentials.md for future agents.
test_credentials: Admin: username=donas, password=Seinao10@@ (verified working; NOT present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Root bug (blank dark-blue page / Emergent default template at '/') is FIXED and verified stable across restarts. Routes verified via external URL: '/' and /inicio.html -> 'Instituto AOCP - Concursos Publicos'; /inscricao.html, /termos.html, /confirmacao.html, /inscricao-realizada.html, /pagamento-pix.html all return correct titles/content; GET /api/ -> {"message":"Painel Administrativo API"}; POST /api/admin/auth/login (donas/Seinao10@@) -> JWT+user, wrong pw -> 401; /donaspainel and /donaspainel/anything -> admin SPA shell (Painel - AOCP PE 2026).
rca of the issue: RCA: webpack-dev-server's HtmlWebpackPlugin was briefly serving the default CRA Emergent template at '/'. Fix hardens craco.config.js by registering 'serve-user-html' middleware via middlewares.unshift AFTER the visual-edits wrapper, using fs.readFileSync+res.setHeader+res.end (res.sendFile was unavailable on the middleware stack, causing errors) and safe reqPath derivation. Verified: no template leak across 2 restarts; only transient ingress 502 during startup bind window.
